purpose: Reconstruct and rerank remaining CSOS families under one Dukascopy BI5 Bid/Ask Tick authority for independent alpha and portfolio complementarity.

parallel_firewall.separate_from: Short Pullback Continuation Directional Asymmetry and Historical Portability Study

bar_contract.price: Bid OHLC reconstructed from the same Tick source
bar_contract.observed_bar: A bar exists only when at least one source Tick is observed in its UTC 15-minute bucket
bar_contract.duplicates: stable source order retained and audited
bar_contract.nonmonotonic: must be zero after deterministic stable chronology
bar_contract.missing_intervals: not forward-filled; family missing-data rules apply
bar_contract.tail: suppressed when fixed exit cannot be executed

execution_contract.long_entry: first executable Ask at or after frozen entry boundary
execution_contract.short_entry: first executable Bid at or after frozen entry boundary
execution_contract.long_exit: first executable Bid at or after frozen exit boundary
execution_contract.short_exit: first executable Ask at or after frozen exit boundary

monetary_contract.floating_point_normalization: absolute values below tolerance normalized to zero

excluded_families.D_SHOCK_FAILURE: binding independent study and postmortem complete
excluded_families.F_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP: HYP-030, HYP-031, HYP-033 and HYP-034 complete
excluded_families.J_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION: HYP-035, HYP-036 and parallel successor study

translation_rule: Each old CSOS frozen variant is translated exactly once. Unspecified or non-executable rules are not guessed or tuned and receive NOT_EXECUTABLE_UNDER_COMMON_SOURCE_CONTRACT.
